profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Grainger
profile.summary:
I am working in Motorola Solutions Inc as a Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer.

Languages: C, C++, Python, Node.js, HMTL5, CSS3, JAVASCRIPT, XML, JSON, AJAX, REST, SOAP
Cloud: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
DevOps: Jenkins, Docker, Container, Terraform
Software: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Project, Visio, Git, Subversion, Eclipse, Visual Studio, VS Code, Vim
Atlassian: JIRA, Confluence
Version Control tool: Git, Bitbucket
Operating Systems: Windows, LINUX, iOS 
Database: MySQL Server, MS SQL Server, Oracle, NoSQL
ITIL Process tool: Service Now

Experienced in AWS Cloud services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop and support Grainger’s IoT distributed devices platform using AWS cloud services and DevOps technologies.
•	Work collaboratively with Engineers and Architects to develop product design and deliver solutions in a cloud environment.
•	Use container technologies to make the infrastructure and platform portable and scalable.
•	Develop, create, and modify existing data software to correct errors and allow it to adapt to new hardware and improve its performance.
•	Work with Product Managers by providing input into planning and execution of product roadmaps and backlog priorities.
•	Responsible for developing and supporting Grainger's IoT environment using AWS services like AWS GreenGrass, AWS IoT Core and AWS Device Management.
•	Implement micro services using AWS Lambda and container to perform back end operations for IoT devices.
•	Responsible for developing, implementing and deploying the monitoring tool that captures devices health metrics info in the field and send alerts in case of failures using AWS services like AWS Cloudwatch, AWS TimeStream, AWS Lambda and AWS EKS.
•	Implement REST APIs to perform hardware related operations for different machine types that is used by the vending application to perform dispense tasks.
•	Work in a test driven development environment that involves writing unit test cases for all the components and its functionalities.

positions.title: Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
•Working as a Cloud DevOps Engineer in the Cloud Platform and Automation Team to lead the way in delivering the necessary automation tools and development framework using API management and orchestration to optimize and make the environment more efficient.
•Developed Self Service platform for the Cloud-Ops team as well as for the customers to automate deployment of AWS/Azure services and optimize self-service cloud operations (metrics, cost reports, inventory, etc.) resulting in signification reduction of tickets and turnaround time for users from days to mins. (Python, NodeJS, Flask, OKTA, Bootstrap, Boto3, Jenkins, Terraform, AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, Swagger REST APIs)
•Integrated Service Now within the automation tool to help customers review and deploy the AWS service requests coming in on day-to-day basis.
•For the Infrastructure as Code platform, wrote various micro-services and setup various data stores and their corresponding API's for better and efficient management of data and requests. (Python, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Jenkins, Terraform, AWS Lambda)
•Implemented Python scripts using lambda function to enable S3 bucket encryption in the AWS accounts using AWS KMS Server Side Encryption technique which as a result encrypts S3 buckets on board to make it secure.
• Implemented Key Rotation Policy for the IAM users for all the AWS accounts using lambda function and CloudWatch triggers that sends email reminders to IAM users after certain key age and rotate keys as per to match security standards and practices.
• Created Jenkins pipelines using Terraform templates and Python/bash scripting to automate provisioning of AWS resources.
•Implemented a microservice to fetch firewall traffic logs for a given object using Splunk and Panorama APIs for customer's better network level visibility.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Working as a Software Developer in GEE’s Digital Media Services (DMS) department for the Portal Development of inflight entertainment applications. 
•	Develop web portals to provide airlines (Icelandair, Avianca, Airchina) with a wide range of inflight solutions that includes Wi-Fi, movies, television, music, interactive software, as well as portable IFE solutions, content management services, e-commerce solutions and original content development.
•	My primary role is to develop, troubleshoot and deploy Python based applications using Pyramid and Django web frameworks and front-end technologies like HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Jquery, Angular JS in the Linux environment and working on a unique satellite connectivity system for the inflight entertainment, which includes Wi-Fi purchase, streaming videos, advertisements and statistical/operational data using REST, SOAP, JSON and XML.
•	Also involved in the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) of the Project that also includes Shell Scripting, ssh/ftp and command-line tools. 
•	Environment: Python, Pyramid, Django, HTML5, CSS3,  XHTML, JavaScript, jQuery, MySQL, REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, Linux, Vim, Subversion, Agile.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
- Have been working as a Programmer Analyst at Caterpillar in the CAT Engine System Products department to develop an advanced database-driven web application using languages like HTML5, CSS, JavaScript , JQuery, AJAX, JSON, PHP and MYSQL server which helps the supervisors to manage several projects simultaneously and to keep track of their project status through visual representation of graphs and charts using Google Charts. 
- I used Wordpress and Bootstrap to design the creative layout of the web application and for developing dashboards. 
- Created a normalized database structure for the web application using joins, stored procedures and triggers in MySQL server as per the requirement of the web app. 
- Also worked on the process improvements of several simulation tools using Python.
- Environment: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Python, Bootstrap, MySQL, Subversion, Agile

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked as a Java Software Engineer at Caterpillar in the CAT Engine Diagnostics department in an Agile environment on a Windows platform thereby providing support to their CMPS (CAT Monitoring and Protection System) tool by troubleshooting issues in the tool and to enhance it using Java on the GIT (source version control system) platform. 
•	Also worked on the System Architect (CAT tool), which helps in generating the data provided by the CMPS in to the Java code.
•	Environment: Java, Windows, Eclipse, XML, Notepad++, Python, Git, Agile

positions.title: Student
positions.description: I studied Masters in Computer Science at Illinois Institute of Technology with the specialization in Software Engineering. I graduated in May 2014.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: I have experience of working as an Intern at Implicit Solutions Company in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India which develops applications for iPhones and Android Phones as well as develops websites for multinational companies in which I developed an Android based marker networking and chatting application using Java in the Eclipse software which is used to locate the position of friends using Global Positioning System and also provides with a chatting feature. I have also developed a matrimonial website using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, XML and PHP

projects.title: Software system Architecture
projects.description:
•Studied Object Oriented Analysis and Design (OOAD) Pattern Concepts and designed architecture for the Vending Machine which offers tea, coffee and chocolate with different additives using Model Driven Architecture and by using different patterns that includes state pattern, abstract factory pattern and strategy pattern.
•Also implemented this design in Java and made the Vending Machine run correctly.

projects.title: Software Model Based and Transition Based Testing Project
projects.description:
I studied a subject named Software Testing and Analysis in my masters and did this project which was a term project(individual project).
The ATM system and its functionality were given in the project along with the source code.
There were certain defects in the source code which I had to detect and test them.
I detected those defects and developed test cases using Model Based Testing, Transition Based Testing ,Automated Testing and implemented it using the Test Suite.
